lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three primary vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits. The central column contains approximately 5 distinct nodes of high pixel intensity arranged linearly.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of spots, most visible in the mid-lateral region posterior to the fifth gill slit, forming a non-uniform grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank; the dorsal-most ridge exhibits a sharp transition from high luminance on the upper edge to deep shadow on the lower edge.
